about_the_game:
SANTA'S COOKIES
Online co-op horror game where elves (players) run for their lives in an expansive north pole workshop from an evil-turned Santa Claus. To survive, the elves must attempt to bake extremely questionable "healing" cookies to bring him back. 


SANTA'S DOWNFALL
Santa's got his hands on some evil, poisoned cookies; careless to check them first, his desire to eat them out-weighed any precautions. As he gnawed, chewed and slurped every cookie and crumb, his skin began to fade pale, and his eyes turned to those of a demons. Santa was no longer in control and his desire was not for cookies, but for elves...


SURVIVE
You’re an Elf and the workshop is on lockdown; there’s no escaping. Instead read an ancient recipe book, written with questionable sanity, that was made specifically for a time like this. It reads a recipe of ingredients telling you how to make cookies that can bring the old man back. Start throwing what you can find into the mixer and bake away! Just maybe you can make the dessert before becoming the dessert!
